decisions.question: D10-Q03, D11-Q03
decisions.rule: While the chain is frozen, or in a block with an emergency control, a kit replacement is not admitted, as upgrades and handovers signed by the same keys are not. The freeze stays a full brake on the upgrade keys. No recovery is lost: the three kits that could sign a replacement can sign a resume first. A replacement already admitted still takes effect at its effect height.

supersedes: The design note that a replacement is admitted during a freeze (root kit replacement v1, Effect)
unset: The implementation (steps K2b to K4 of the design) and its staging drill
